scenario: 面试官让你先讲清 ML 服务的三种范式，以及每种主要在优化什么。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to lay out the three ML serving paradigms and what each mainly optimizes.
q: ML 服务的三种范式是什么，各自的定位是什么？
q_en: What are the three ML serving paradigms and what does each optimize?
why: 同步在请求路径上一次往返出结果（低延迟）、异步按计划预算好存起来（低成本）、流式秒级更新（新鲜度）。服务架构同时决定延迟、成本和新鲜度，大规模系统常混用。
why_en: Synchronous (real-time, one HTTP round-trip, low latency), asynchronous (batch, pre-computed on a schedule, low cost), and streaming (near-real-time, seconds, freshness) — and large systems usually mix them.
diagram:
flowchart LR S["同步/实时
毫秒级 主打延迟"] A["异步/批处理
小时级 主打成本"] T["流式/近实时
秒级 主打新鲜度"]
options: 同步主打低延迟、异步主打低成本、流式主打新鲜度
只有同步和异步两种，流式只是异步的别名，没有第三种
三种范式优化的是同一目标（延迟），只是实现语言不同
三种范式指训练、验证、测试三个阶段，与线上服务无关
options_en: Synchronous optimizes low latency, asynchronous optimizes cost, streaming optimizes freshness.
Only synchronous and asynchronous exist; streaming is just another name for asynchronous, no third type.
All three optimize the same goal (latency) and differ only in implementation language.
The three paradigms are the train/validation/test stages, unrelated to online serving.
optionExplanations: 对；三种范式各有主打维度，服务架构是同时权衡延迟、成本、新鲜度的核心选择，常混用。
流式是独立的第三种（近实时、秒级），不是异步别名，异步是小时级批处理。
三者优化目标不同：同步保延迟、异步压成本、流式抢新鲜度，不是同一目标。
这是把服务范式和训练数据划分搞混了，三范式说的是线上出预测的方式。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — each paradigm has a lead dimension, and serving is the core tradeoff among latency, cost, and freshness, often mixed.
Streaming is a distinct third type (near-real-time, seconds), not an alias for async, which is hourly batch.
Their goals differ: sync guards latency, async cuts cost, streaming chases freshness — not one goal.
This confuses serving paradigms with training-data splits; the three describe how predictions are produced online.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把训练好的模型接入线上、产出预测的方式；同时决定用户延迟、基础设施成本和数据新鲜度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A serving architecture is how a trained model produces predictions online, jointly shaping user latency, infrastructure cost, and data freshness.

termDefinitions.meaning: 指 Meta、Amazon、Apple、Netflix、Google 这类超大规模互联网公司的统称。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MAANG refers to hyperscale internet companies like Meta, Amazon, Apple, Netflix, and Google.

scenario: 面试官要你在一张表里对比同步、异步、流式的延迟、成本和训练-服务偏斜风险。
scenario_en: The interviewer wants a table contrasting sync, async, and streaming on latency, cost, and training-serving skew risk.
q: 同步、异步、流式在延迟/成本/偏斜风险上怎么对比？
q_en: How do sync, async, and streaming contrast on latency, cost, and skew risk?
why: 同步：毫秒级延迟、成本最高、偏斜风险高（在线特征逻辑易与离线训练管线分叉）；异步：小时级、成本最低、偏斜风险低（复用同一套离线特征管线）；流式：秒到分钟级、成本居中、偏斜风险中等。这条对比是选范式的地图。
why_en: Sync is ms latency, highest cost, high skew risk; async is hours, cheapest, low skew; streaming is seconds-to-minutes, moderate cost and moderate skew.
tradeoff: 同步（低延迟但贵+高偏斜）vs 异步（便宜+低偏斜但陈旧）vs 流式（新鲜但运维复杂、居中）
options: 三种范式的延迟、成本、偏斜风险都相同，选哪种都一样
同步毫秒/最贵/高偏斜；异步小时/最省/低偏斜；流式居中
异步延迟最低、成本最高，同步延迟最高、成本最低，正好相反
偏斜风险只由模型大小决定，与服务范式和特征计算路径无关
options_en: All three have identical latency, cost, and skew risk, so it doesn't matter which you pick.
Sync: ms, priciest, high skew; async: hours, cheapest, low skew; streaming sits in between.
Async has the lowest latency and highest cost, sync the highest latency and lowest cost — reversed.
Skew risk is decided only by model size, unrelated to the paradigm or the feature path.
optionExplanations: 三者在三条维度上系统性不同，正是这些差异决定了按约束选范式。
对；这张对比表是选范式的中立地图，本题答案由具体延迟/成本/新鲜度约束在图上选行。
彻底说反了：同步才是最低延迟最高成本，异步才是最高延迟最低成本。
偏斜来自在线特征逻辑与离线训练管线是否一致，服务范式直接影响它——同步最高、异步最低。
optionExplanations_en: The three differ systematically on all three axes, and those differences drive constraint-based choice.
Correct — this table is the neutral map; the answer for a case is chosen by the actual latency/cost/freshness constraints.
Fully reversed: sync is lowest latency and highest cost, async is highest latency and lowest cost.
Skew comes from whether online feature logic matches the offline training pipeline; the paradigm strongly affects it — highest for sync, lowest for batch.

termDefinitions.term: training-serving skew / 训练-服务偏斜
termDefinitions.meaning: 线上服务时的特征/逻辑与离线训练时不一致，导致模型线上表现劣于离线，是三种范式共有的首要风险。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is a mismatch between features/logic at serving time and at training time, degrading online performance — the shared first-order risk.

scenario: 模型离线评估很好，上线后指标明显掉，你怀疑训练和服务时算特征的方式不一致。
scenario_en: A model evaluates well offline but drops in production; you suspect features are computed differently at training vs serving time.
q: 训练-服务偏斜是什么，为什么是所有服务范式的首要风险？
q_en: What is training-serving skew, and why is it the first-order risk across all paradigms?
why: 偏斜=服务时的特征计算或分布与训练时不一致：同一个「近 7 天点击数」线上现算、离线批算，一分叉模型就吃到陌生输入而掉点。三种范式都有，同步最危险。
why_en: Skew is when serving-time feature computation diverges from training, so the model sees different inputs than it learned on and degrades; it spans all paradigms, worst in sync, mitigated by mirroring the training pipeline.
options: 偏斜指模型太大装不进显存，与特征计算无关，扩显存或换卡即可
服务时特征计算/分布与训练时不一致，模型吃到不同输入而掉点
偏斜只在异步批处理里出现，同步和流式天然免疫
偏斜是网络延迟抖动，加 CDN 就能消除
options_en: Skew means the model no longer fits in GPU memory; unrelated to features, just add memory or swap cards.
Serving-time feature computation or distribution diverges from training, so the model sees different inputs and degrades.
Skew only appears in async batch; sync and streaming are naturally immune.
Skew is network latency jitter, removable with a CDN.
optionExplanations: 偏斜是特征/分布不一致的问题，不是显存问题，扩显存无关。
对；训练与服务的特征逻辑一分叉，模型输入就变了、线上掉点；同步在线现算特征最容易分叉。
恰恰相反：异步复用离线管线偏斜最低，同步现算特征偏斜最高，没有范式天然免疫。
偏斜是数据/特征一致性问题，不是网络抖动，CDN 解决不了。
optionExplanations_en: Skew is a feature/distribution mismatch, not a memory issue; adding GPU memory is irrelevant.
Correct — once training and serving feature logic diverge, the model's inputs change and it degrades; sync computing features live diverges most easily.
The opposite: async reusing offline pipelines has the lowest skew, sync computing features live the highest; no paradigm is immune.
Skew is a data/feature consistency problem, not network jitter, so a CDN can't fix it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 统一存放特征、并让训练与在线服务读同一份特征定义的系统，是抑制训练-服务偏斜的关键层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store centrally holds features so training and online serving read the same definitions, a key layer for suppressing training-serving skew.

scenario: Stripe 要在一笔支付「完成之前」判定是否欺诈并放行/拒绝，预测就卡在关键路径上，用户在等结果。
scenario_en: Stripe must decide fraud approve/decline before a payment completes, so the prediction sits on the critical path with the user waiting.
q: 预测卡在同步关键路径上，该用哪种服务范式？
q_en: When prediction is on the synchronous critical path, which paradigm?
why: 用同步实时推理：请求→模型服务器→响应一次 HTTP 往返内出结果，因为放行/拒绝必须在支付完成前给出，等不了预计算或批处理。代价是成本最高、要按峰值常备算力，还常需量化/蒸馏压到延迟预算内。
why_en: Use synchronous real-time inference — request to model server to response in one HTTP round-trip — because the decision must return before the payment completes, at the cost of highest, peak-provisioned compute.
tradeoff: 同步（关键路径必须即时出结果，但成本最高）vs 批处理（便宜，但结果不在请求路径上、来不及）
whenOtherWins: 如果预测不在用户等待的关键路径上、可容忍小时级陈旧（如离线批量算推荐再存起来），就该用异步批处理省成本。
options: 异步批处理：每晚预算好所有交易的欺诈分，白天查表返回
同步实时推理：一次往返内出结果，支付完成前给出放行/拒绝
流式近实时：把交易打进 Kafka，几秒内算完再回写
先不决策，交易照常放行，事后每晚批量复核可疑交易再追回
options_en: Async batch: pre-compute fraud scores for all transactions overnight and look them up during the day.
Synchronous real-time inference: one round-trip decides approve or decline before the payment completes.
Streaming near-real-time: push transactions into Kafka and score within a few seconds before writing back.
Don't decide up front — approve everything and batch-review suspicious transactions nightly to claw back.
optionExplanations: 批处理预算的是过去的交易，新交易还没发生就没有分，无法在支付完成前给出放行/拒绝。
对；决策卡在支付完成前的关键路径上，只有同步一次往返能满足，代价是成本最高。
秒级对支付授权还是太慢，用户和商户在同步等一个即时的批准/拒绝，流式追不上。
先放行再事后复核意味着欺诈交易已经成功，违背「完成前决策」的硬约束。
optionExplanations_en: Batch pre-computes past transactions; a brand-new one has no score yet, so it can't approve/decline before completion.
Correct — the decision is on the critical path before payment completes, and only a synchronous round-trip meets it, at highest cost.
Seconds is still too slow for payment authorization; the user and merchant wait synchronously for an instant approve/decline.
Approve-then-review means the fraudulent transaction already succeeded, breaking the decide-before-completion constraint.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户请求必须等待其完成才能继续的处理链路；卡在关键路径上的预测必须同步、即时返回。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The critical path is the processing chain a user request must wait on to proceed; a prediction on it must return synchronously and instantly.

scenario: 要给一个同步实时推理服务画基础设施：如何在个位数毫秒内组装特征并出预测。
scenario_en: Sketch the infra for a synchronous real-time inference service: how to assemble features and predict in single-digit ms.
q: 同步实时推理的典型基础设施长什么样？
q_en: What does typical synchronous real-time inference infra look like?
why: API 网关→负载均衡→模型服务器（TensorFlow Serving、Triton）按 QPS 扩缩，特征在请求时从 Redis/DynamoDB 个位数毫秒取出。整条链路都为一次往返内出结果服务。
why_en: API gateway to model servers (TensorFlow Serving, Triton) behind load balancers autoscaled on QPS, with features assembled at request time from a low-latency store (Redis, DynamoDB) in single-digit ms.
diagram:
flowchart LR U["请求"] --> G["API 网关"] --> LB["负载均衡"] --> M["模型服务器
TF Serving/Triton"] FS["低延迟特征存储
Redis/DynamoDB"] --> M M --> R["响应"]
options: 每晚 Spark 批量打分写进 KV，白天只查表，不做在线推理
API 网关→LB→模型服务器按 QPS 扩缩，请求时从 Redis 取特征
事件进 Kafka 由 Flink 窗口聚合后再异步回写特征库
把模型整个嵌进客户端 App，完全不需要任何服务器端推理设施
options_en: Nightly Spark batch scores into a KV store; daytime is lookup-only with no online inference.
API gateway to a load balancer to model servers autoscaled on QPS, with features fetched from Redis at request time.
Events go into Kafka, Flink aggregates windows, then asynchronously writes back to the feature store.
Embed the whole model inside the client app so no server-side inference infrastructure exists.
optionExplanations: 这是异步批处理的架构（Spark 打分、查表），不是同步在线推理。
对；网关+模型服务器+按 QPS 扩缩+请求时低延迟取特征，正是同步实时的标配，全为延迟预算服务。
Kafka+Flink 窗口聚合是流式管线，不是一次 HTTP 往返内出结果的同步推理。
端上推理是另一类方案，题问的是服务器端同步实时推理的典型基础设施。
optionExplanations_en: That's async batch (Spark scoring, lookup), not synchronous online inference.
Correct — gateway plus model servers plus QPS autoscaling plus request-time low-latency features is the sync real-time standard, all for the latency budget.
Kafka plus Flink windowing is a streaming pipeline, not one-round-trip synchronous inference.
On-device inference is a different approach; the question is server-side synchronous real-time infra.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒查询数，衡量请求负载；同步服务按 QPS 自动扩缩模型服务器数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS (Queries Per Second) measures request load; synchronous services autoscale model-server count on QPS.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生产级模型推理服务器：把训练好的模型包成高吞吐、低延迟的在线服务端点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TensorFlow Serving and Triton are production model-inference servers that expose a trained model as a high-throughput, low-latency online endpoint.

termDefinitions.meaning: 低延迟键值存储：Redis 是内存 KV，DynamoDB 是托管 KV，用于请求时个位数毫秒取特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis (in-memory KV) and DynamoDB (managed KV) are low-latency key-value stores used to fetch features in single-digit ms at request time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式消息队列，把事件按主题持久化排队，供下游流处理消费。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed message queue that durably buffers events by topic for downstream stream processors to consume.

termDefinitions.meaning: 流处理引擎，对事件流做有状态的窗口聚合与实时计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Flink is a stream processing engine that runs stateful windowed aggregations over event streams in real time.

scenario: 财务问：为什么同步实时推理是三种范式里最烧钱的？
scenario_en: Finance asks: why is synchronous real-time inference the most expensive of the three paradigms?
q: 为什么同步实时服务成本最高？
q_en: Why is synchronous real-time serving the most expensive?
why: 因为它要为峰值和尾延迟常备算力：GPU/CPU 得一直在线待命、按最高 QPS 和 p99 尾延迟做容量规划，空闲时段也在烧钱。相比之下批处理能把机器用完即走、跑 spot 抢占实例，所以同步最贵。
why_en: It must keep GPU/CPU always-on and provisioned for peak QPS and p99 tail latency, burning money even when idle, whereas batch spins up ephemerally on spot instances.
options: 为峰值和 p99 尾延迟常备在线算力，空闲时段也在烧钱
因为它每次请求都要重新训练一遍模型，训练开销随流量线性增长
因为它必须把全部历史数据常驻内存才能响应，内存账单最贵
其实它最便宜，只是模型服务器的许可证和监控费用偏高
options_en: It keeps always-on compute provisioned for peak and p99 tail latency, burning money even when idle.
Because it retrains the model on every request, so training cost grows linearly with traffic.
Because it must keep all historical data resident in memory to respond, making RAM the top bill.
Actually it's the cheapest; only the model server's license and monitoring fees run high.
optionExplanations: 对；常备算力+按峰值和 p99 尾延迟规划容量是同步成本高的根因，空闲时段也停不下来。
同步推理只做前向推理，不在请求时重训模型，这不是成本来源。
推理只需模型权重和请求特征，不需要把全部历史数据装进内存。
同步恰恰是三者里最贵的，不是最便宜，成本来自常备算力而非许可证。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — always-on compute sized for peak and p99 tail latency is why sync costs most; you can't spin it down when idle.
Sync inference only does a forward pass, not retraining per request — not the cost source.
Inference needs only model weights and request features, not all historical data in memory.
Sync is the most expensive of the three, not the cheapest, and the cost is always-on compute, not licensing.

termDefinitions.term: p99 tail latency / p99 尾延迟
termDefinitions.meaning: 99% 请求快于该延迟、最慢 1% 的延迟上界；同步服务要按尾延迟而非平均值做容量规划。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: p99 tail latency is the bound below which 99% of requests fall; sync services must be sized by the tail, not the average.

termDefinitions.meaning: 云厂商可随时回收的廉价临时算力，适合可中断的批处理任务，同步在线服务不能用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Spot/preemptible instances are cheap, reclaimable compute suited to interruptible batch jobs, not always-on synchronous serving.

scenario: 同步服务的模型太大、跑不进个位数到几十毫秒的延迟预算，你要压小它。
scenario_en: A synchronous service's model is too big for the single-to-tens-of-ms latency budget; you must shrink it.
q: 哪些技术常用来把同步模型压进延迟预算？(多选)
q_en: Which techniques are commonly used to fit a sync model into the latency budget? (multiple)
why: 量化（用低精度如 int8 表示权重，减小体积、加速推理）、蒸馏（用大模型教出一个更小更快的学生模型）、ONNX（跨框架的优化推理运行时/格式）都能压延迟。加更多历史训练数据不改变推理延迟，跑题。
why_en: Quantization, distillation, and ONNX all cut inference latency, while adding more training data doesn't change serving latency.
options: 量化：用 int8 等低精度表示权重，减小体积、加速推理
蒸馏：用大模型教出一个更小更快的学生模型顶替上线
ONNX：跨框架的优化推理运行时/格式，提速推理
加更多历史训练数据，让模型见得更多
options_en: Quantization: represent weights in low precision like int8 to shrink size and speed inference.
Distillation: train a smaller, faster student model from a large teacher to serve instead.
ONNX: a cross-framework optimized inference runtime/format that speeds inference.
Add more historical training data so the model sees more examples.
optionExplanations: 对；量化把权重降到 int8 等低精度，模型更小、算得更快，直接砍推理延迟。
对；蒸馏出的小学生模型延迟更低，用它上线换取延迟预算，代价是略损精度。
对；ONNX 运行时对算子做图优化、跨框架加速，是压推理延迟的常用手段。
错；加训练数据影响的是模型质量和训练时长，不改变线上单次推理延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — quantization drops weights to int8-like precision, shrinking the model and speeding compute, directly cutting inference latency.
Correct — a distilled student model has lower latency; serving it buys the latency budget at slight accuracy cost.
Correct — the ONNX runtime graph-optimizes operators and accelerates across frameworks, a common latency-cutting tool.
Wrong — more training data affects model quality and training time, not per-request serving latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型权重从高精度（fp32）降到低精度（int8）表示，减小体积、加速推理，略损精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quantization lowers model weights from high precision (fp32) to low precision (int8) to shrink size and speed inference at slight accuracy cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用大模型（teacher）的输出训练一个更小的学生模型，逼近其能力但延迟更低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distillation trains a smaller student model from a large teacher's outputs to approximate it at lower latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 跨框架的模型交换格式与优化推理运行时，用于加速线上推理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange) is a cross-framework model format and optimized inference runtime used to accelerate serving.

scenario: 同步服务在请求时用一套在线代码现算特征，而训练时特征是另一套离线管线算的。
scenario_en: A sync service computes features live with online code at request time, while training used a separate offline pipeline.
q: 为什么训练-服务偏斜在同步范式里最危险，怎么防？
q_en: Why is training-serving skew most dangerous in the synchronous paradigm, and how to guard?
why: 同步要在请求时用在线代码现算特征，这套逻辑最容易和离线训练管线分叉（单位、缺失值、时间窗口口径不同），模型吃到与训练时不同的输入而线上掉点。防法是校验在线特征逻辑严格镜像训练管线，最好共用同一个特征存储/定义。
why_en: Sync computes features live with online code that most easily diverges from the offline training pipeline, so validate that online logic exactly mirrors training, ideally via a shared feature store.
options: 因为同步不需要特征，全靠模型参数直接出结果，偏斜无从谈起
同步在请求时用在线代码现算特征，最易与离线训练管线分叉
因为同步的偏斜来自 GPU 温度过高，加散热即可
同步其实偏斜最低，因为它跑得最快、数据来不及漂移
options_en: Because sync needs no features at all and answers from model weights alone, so skew cannot arise.
Sync computes features live with online code, which most easily diverges from the offline training pipeline.
Because sync's skew comes from GPU overheating, fixable with more cooling.
Sync actually has the least skew because it runs fastest and data has no time to drift.
optionExplanations: 同步当然需要特征，还得在请求时现算，正因此最容易分叉。
对；在线现算与离线管线一分叉，模型输入就变了；镜像训练逻辑、共用特征存储是标准防法。
偏斜是特征一致性问题，与 GPU 温度无关，散热解决不了。
同步偏斜最高不是最低，速度快和偏斜低是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: Sync does need features, computed live at request time, which is exactly why it diverges most.
Correct — once live computation diverges from the offline pipeline the inputs change; mirroring training logic and sharing a feature store is the standard guard.
Skew is feature consistency, unrelated to GPU temperature, so cooling won't help.
Sync has the highest skew, not lowest; being fast is unrelated to skew.

termDefinitions.term: online feature logic / 在线特征逻辑
termDefinitions.meaning: 同步服务在请求时实时计算特征的代码；若与离线训练管线口径不一致就产生偏斜。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Online feature logic is the code a sync service runs to compute features live at request time; if it doesn't match the offline training pipeline, skew results.

scenario: Netflix 每晚给每个用户 × 候选集算推荐，几十亿条，白天用户打开首页要求个位毫秒返回，且当天新鲜度可以放宽。
scenario_en: Netflix scores every user × candidate set nightly (billions of rows); the daytime homepage needs sub-ms return and same-day freshness is relaxed.
q: 这种「预测集有界、新鲜度可放宽、量极大」的场景该用哪种范式？
q_en: Which paradigm fits a bounded prediction set, relaxed freshness, and huge volume?
why: 用异步批处理：每晚 Spark 大批量给所有用户×候选打分写进 KV 存储，白天 App 做亚毫秒查表而非在线推理。大 batch 把 GPU 利用率拉满、还能跑 spot 抢占实例，成本最低；代价是结果陈旧到下一批才更新。
why_en: Use async batch — nightly Spark scores all users x candidates into a KV store and the app does sub-ms lookups instead of inference — maximizing GPU utilization cheaply, at the cost of staleness.
tradeoff: 异步批处理（成本最低、亚毫秒查表，但结果陈旧）vs 同步（永远新鲜，但按峰值常备算力、最贵）
whenOtherWins: 如果需要基于用户此刻行为的即时预测（如刚搜完就要更新的结果）、或预测集无法预先枚举，就得上同步或流式，批处理的陈旧无法接受。
options: 同步实时：每次用户打开首页都现场跑一次模型算全部候选
异步批处理：每晚 Spark 批量打分写 KV，白天亚毫秒查表
流式近实时：每个用户行为事件都进 Kafka 触发重算
把所有推荐硬编码成全站统一的固定热门榜单，完全不用模型
options_en: Synchronous real-time: run the model over every candidate each time a user opens the homepage.
Async batch: nightly Spark scoring written into a KV store, with sub-millisecond lookups during the day.
Streaming near-real-time: every user behavior event enters Kafka and triggers a re-score.
Hard-code every recommendation into one site-wide fixed popularity chart with no model at all.
optionExplanations: 预测集有界、新鲜度可放宽时，每次现算推理是浪费——同步最贵，这里没必要。
对；大 batch 预算好写 KV、白天查表，GPU 利用率高、可用 spot、成本最低，正好匹配可放宽新鲜度。
为每个事件实时重算是流式，成本和运维都更高，这里新鲜度可放宽用不着。
硬编码榜单丢掉了个性化，不是「用模型给每个用户×候选打分」的推荐系统。
optionExplanations_en: With a bounded set and relaxed freshness, re-inferring each time is wasteful — sync is priciest and unnecessary here.
Correct — large batches into KV plus daytime lookups give high GPU utilization, spot usage, and lowest cost, matching relaxed freshness.
Re-scoring per event is streaming, costlier to run and operate, and unneeded when freshness is relaxed.
A hard-coded chart drops personalization; it's not a model scoring every user x candidate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按计划（小时/天/周）离线大批量预算预测并存起来，服务时查表而非推理的范式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Asynchronous batch pre-computes predictions offline on a schedule (hourly/daily/weekly) and stores them, serving via lookup instead of inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式大数据批处理引擎，常用来给海量用户×候选批量打分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Spark is a distributed big-data batch engine commonly used to score massive user x candidate sets.

scenario: 面试官问：为什么异步批处理是三种范式里最便宜的？
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: why is async batch the cheapest of the three paradigms?
q: 为什么异步批处理成本最低？
q_en: Why is async batch the cheapest paradigm?
why: 因为它按计划跑、用完即走：大 batch 把 GPU 利用率拉满（一次处理海量样本，摊薄启动开销），机器是临时起的、可跑便宜的 spot/抢占实例，由 Airflow 编排。不像同步要按峰值常备在线算力，所以最省。
why_en: It runs on a schedule and spins down: large batches max GPU utilization and it uses cheap ephemeral spot/preemptible instances orchestrated by Airflow, versus sync's always-on peak provisioning.
options: 因为它每次只算一个样本，显存占用小、可以用最便宜的机器
按计划跑、用完即走，大 batch 拉满 GPU 利用率
因为它根本不需要模型，直接从数据库查历史平均值返回
因为它把推理都放到用户手机上跑，服务端几乎零算力成本
options_en: Because it scores one sample at a time, using little memory so the cheapest machines suffice.
It runs on a schedule and spins down, with big batches maxing GPU utilization.
Because it needs no model at all and just returns a historical average from the database.
Because it pushes inference onto users phones, leaving nearly zero server-side compute cost.
optionExplanations: 恰恰相反：批处理一次算海量样本（大 batch），高利用率正是它便宜的原因，不是逐样本。
对；计划性、可中断、大 batch 高利用率、spot 便宜，这些叠加让异步成本最低。
批处理当然要用模型打分，只是把打分结果存起来供查，不是纯查数据库。
端上推理是另一类方案；异步批处理是服务端定时大批量打分，不是手机推理。
optionExplanations_en: The opposite: batch processes huge sample sets at once (large batches), and high utilization is why it's cheap, not per-sample.
Correct — scheduled, interruptible, high-utilization large batches on cheap spot instances make async the lowest cost.
Batch still runs the model to score; it just stores results for lookup, not pure DB queries.
On-device inference is different; async batch is scheduled server-side bulk scoring, not phone inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 工作流编排工具，用有向无环图调度定时批处理任务（如每晚打分作业）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Airflow is a workflow orchestrator that schedules batch jobs as DAGs, e.g. nightly scoring runs.

termDefinitions.meaning: GPU 计算资源被有效使用的比例；大 batch 一次喂满 GPU，利用率高、单条成本低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GPU utilization is the fraction of GPU compute effectively used; large batches keep it high, lowering per-item cost.

scenario: 用户中午搜了徒步靴，但推荐首页到晚上还在给他看昨天那批推荐，没反映今天的兴趣。
scenario_en: A user searched hiking boots at noon, but the rec homepage still shows yesterday's batch until night, not today's interest.
q: 异步批处理的核心局限是什么，为什么？
q_en: What is async batch's core limitation, and why?
why: 核心局限是陈旧（staleness）：预测在上一批算好后就冻结，直到下一批才更新，所以用户当天的新行为在下次跑批前不会反映到推荐里。这是「按计划预算、服务时查表」这一设计的必然代价，用新鲜度换成本。
why_en: The core limitation is staleness — predictions freeze from the last batch until the next run, so today's new behavior isn't reflected until the next job, the inherent cost of trading freshness for cost.
options: 核心局限是延迟太高，即使是查一次表也要好几秒才返回
陈旧：预测冻结到下一批才更新，当天新行为不被反映
核心局限是成本太高，因为它同样要常备 GPU 在线待命
核心局限是偏斜最严重，因为它在请求时用在线代码现算特征
options_en: The core limit is latency: even a single lookup takes several seconds to return.
Staleness: predictions freeze until the next batch, so the day’s new behavior is not reflected.
The core limit is cost, because it also keeps GPUs provisioned and idling online.
The core limit is worst-case skew, because it computes features live with online code.
optionExplanations: 查表本身是亚毫秒的，延迟不是批处理的问题；它的痛点是新鲜度。
对；预测按批冻结、下一批才更新，是批处理用新鲜度换成本的必然代价。
批处理恰恰成本最低、用完即走，不常备 GPU，成本不是它的局限。
批处理复用离线管线，偏斜最低不是最高；在线现算特征是同步的特征。
optionExplanations_en: The lookup itself is sub-ms; latency isn't batch's problem — freshness is its pain point.
Correct — predictions freeze per batch and update only next run, the inherent freshness-for-cost tradeoff.
Batch is the cheapest and spins down, no always-on GPUs, so cost isn't its limitation.
Batch reuses offline pipelines and has the lowest skew, not the highest; live feature computation is sync's trait.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测反映的是上一次批处理时的状态，不含此后的新数据/新行为，直到下一批才更新。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Staleness means predictions reflect the last batch's state and miss newer data/behavior until the next run.

scenario: 面试官问：为什么异步批处理天然最不容易出训练-服务偏斜？
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: why is async batch naturally least prone to training-serving skew?
q: 为什么异步批处理的偏斜风险最低？
q_en: Why does async batch have the lowest skew risk?
why: 因为打分时复用的就是训练时那套离线特征管线——同一份代码、同一套特征定义算特征，服务侧和训练侧不分叉，自然没有在线/离线口径不一致的偏斜。这与同步在请求时另写一套在线特征逻辑正好相反。
why_en: Because scoring reuses the very same offline feature pipeline as training — same code, same definitions — so serving and training don't diverge, unlike sync's separate online feature logic.
options: 因为批处理复用训练时同一套离线特征管线打分，服务与训练不分叉，天然无偏斜
因为批处理根本不用特征，直接输出随机结果
因为批处理每次都重新训练模型，所以永远最新
因为批处理跑在 GPU 上而训练跑在 CPU 上，硬件不同就没偏斜
options_en: Because batch reuses the same offline feature pipeline as training to score, so serving and training don't diverge — naturally skew-free.
Because batch uses no features and just outputs random results.
Because batch retrains the model each run, so it's always up to date.
Because batch runs on GPU while training runs on CPU, and different hardware means no skew.
optionExplanations: 对；复用同一套离线特征管线是批处理低偏斜的根因——服务和训练算特征的代码一致就不分叉。
批处理当然用特征打分，输出的是模型预测不是随机数。
批处理是打分不是重训模型，低偏斜来自特征管线复用而非重训。
偏斜是特征逻辑一致性问题，与 GPU/CPU 硬件无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — reusing the same offline feature pipeline is why batch has low skew; identical feature code in serving and training doesn't diverge.
Batch does use features to score, outputting model predictions, not random numbers.
Batch scores rather than retrains; low skew comes from pipeline reuse, not retraining.
Skew is feature-logic consistency, unrelated to GPU vs CPU hardware.

termDefinitions.term: offline feature pipeline / 离线特征管线
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时批量计算特征的代码/流程；批处理服务复用它来打分，从而避免训练-服务偏斜。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The offline feature pipeline is the batch feature-computation code used at training; batch serving reuses it to score, avoiding skew.

scenario: Uber 的到达时间预估（ETA）要随路况持续更新，但不需要亚 100ms 的即时响应，几秒内刷新就够、且要贴近当前状态。
scenario_en: Uber ETA must continuously update with traffic but needs no sub-100ms response — refreshing within seconds while staying close to current state is enough.
q: 「要新鲜但不卡死延迟、要持续更新」的场景该用哪种范式？
q_en: Which paradigm fits fresh-but-not-ultra-low-latency continuous updates?
why: 用流式近实时：事件进 Kafka、Flink 算窗口特征并打分，秒到分钟级更新，填补同步太严和批处理太陈旧之间的空档。代价是运维复杂（精确一次、背压、检查点）。
why_en: Use streaming near-real-time — events into Kafka, Flink computes windowed features and scores in seconds — filling the gap between sync's strict latency and batch's staleness, at the cost of operational complexity.
tradeoff: 流式（秒级新鲜、可跑更重模型，但运维复杂）vs 批处理（更便宜，但陈旧追不上路况）
whenOtherWins: 如果预测卡在用户等待的亚 100ms 关键路径上（支付授权、广告竞价），流式的秒级还是太慢，必须同步；若新鲜度可放宽到小时级则用更省的批处理。
options: 同步实时：每次 ETA 都在用户等待的关键路径上做一次往返推理
流式近实时：事件进 Kafka，Flink 算窗口特征打分，秒级更新
异步批处理：每晚算一次全城 ETA，白天所有请求都直接查表
把 ETA 写死成按距离折算的固定值，不随实时路况变化
options_en: Synchronous real-time: each ETA runs a round-trip inference on the user's waiting critical path.
Streaming near-real-time: events into Kafka, Flink computes windowed features and scores, updating in seconds.
Async batch: compute citywide ETAs once a night and serve every daytime request from a lookup.
Hard-code ETA as a fixed distance-based value that never changes with live traffic.
optionExplanations: ETA 不需要亚 100ms 同步响应，硬上同步是过度设计、成本更高，还没必要。
对；秒级持续更新、贴近当前路况，正是流式的定位，填补同步与批处理之间的新鲜度空档。
每晚算一次太陈旧，跟不上实时变化的路况，批处理的新鲜度不够。
写死 ETA 完全丢掉了随路况更新的需求，等于没有预测。
optionExplanations_en: ETA doesn't need sub-100ms synchronous response; forcing sync over-engineers it at higher cost for no benefit.
Correct — seconds-level continuous updates close to current traffic is streaming's niche, filling the freshness gap between sync and batch.
Nightly is too stale for live-changing traffic; batch's freshness is insufficient.
Hard-coding ETA drops the update-with-traffic requirement, effectively no prediction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 事件经消息队列进流处理器，计算窗口特征并打分，秒到分钟级更新的服务范式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Streaming near-real-time routes events through a queue into a stream processor that computes windowed features and scores in seconds to minutes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预计到达时间，需随路况持续更新，是流式服务的典型应用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival) must update continuously with traffic — a canonical streaming use case.

scenario: 要画一个流式服务的数据流：从事件到打分结果落地。
scenario_en: Sketch a streaming service's data flow from event to scored result.
q: 流式近实时服务的典型管线是什么？
q_en: What is the typical streaming near-real-time pipeline?
why: 事件 → 消息队列（Kafka）→ 流处理器（Flink 或 Spark 结构化流）算窗口特征并打分 → 写低延迟存储或触发下游动作。因为它在 HTTP 往返之外异步处理，可以用比同步更重的模型/集成。
why_en: Events to a message queue (Kafka) to a stream processor (Flink or Spark Structured Streaming) that computes windowed features and scores, then writes to a low-latency store or downstream actions.
diagram:
flowchart LR E["事件"] --> K["消息队列
Kafka"] --> F["流处理器
Flink/Spark Streaming"] F --> W["窗口特征+打分"] --> S["低延迟存储/下游动作"]
options: 请求→模型服务器→一次 HTTP 往返内同步返回结果
事件→Kafka→Flink 算窗口特征打分→写低延迟存储
每晚 Spark 跑一次全量打分写进 KV，白天所有请求查表
把模型下发到客户端，所有事件都在端上本地处理不回传
options_en: Request to model server, synchronous return in one HTTP round-trip.
Events to Kafka, Flink computes windowed features and scores, then writes to a low-latency store.
Nightly Spark scores everything into a KV store and all daytime requests are lookups.
Ship the model to clients so every event is processed locally on-device and never sent back.
optionExplanations: 一次 HTTP 往返同步返回是同步范式，不是事件驱动的流式管线。
对；队列+流处理器+窗口特征打分+写低延迟存储，正是流式近实时的标准管线。
每晚全量打分查表是异步批处理，不是持续处理事件的流式。
端上处理是另一类；流式是服务端消费事件流做窗口计算与打分。
optionExplanations_en: A synchronous one-round-trip return is the sync paradigm, not an event-driven streaming pipeline.
Correct — queue plus stream processor plus windowed-feature scoring into a low-latency store is the streaming standard.
Nightly full scoring with lookups is async batch, not continuous event streaming.
On-device is different; streaming consumes an event stream server-side for windowed computation and scoring.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式消息队列/事件流平台，作为流式管线的入口缓冲并解耦事件生产与消费。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed message queue / event-streaming platform that buffers and decouples event producers from consumers at a streaming pipeline's entry.

termDefinitions.meaning: 流处理引擎，对事件流做有状态的窗口聚合与打分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Flink and Spark Structured Streaming are stream processors that do stateful windowed aggregation and scoring over event streams.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在一段滑动/滚动时间窗内聚合事件算出的特征（如近 30 秒浏览数）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A windowed feature is aggregated over a sliding/tumbling time window (e.g. views in the last 30 seconds).

scenario: 同步服务因延迟预算只能跑压缩过的小模型，你想用更强的集成模型但又要一定新鲜度。
scenario_en: A sync service can only run a compressed small model due to latency budget, but you want a stronger ensemble with some freshness.
q: 为什么流式范式能跑比同步更重的模型？
q_en: Why can streaming run heavier models than synchronous?
why: 因为流式在 HTTP 往返之外异步处理事件，不受「用户在同步等待」的严格延迟预算约束，秒级完成即可。少了这道紧箍咒，就能跑更大的模型或集成来换质量，而同步必须靠量化/蒸馏压小以守住毫秒预算。
why_en: Because streaming processes events asynchronously off the HTTP round-trip, free of sync's strict user-waiting latency budget, so it can run bigger models or ensembles that sync must shrink via quantization/distillation.
options: 因为它在 HTTP 往返之外异步处理，不受同步的延迟预算约束
因为流式框架会自动把模型裁剪得比同步用的更小更快
因为流式其实不跑模型，只做规则匹配和阈值告警
因为流式跑在更贵的专用推理芯片上，算力几乎无上限
options_en: Because it runs asynchronously off the HTTP round-trip, free of sync’s latency budget.
Because streaming frameworks automatically prune models smaller and faster than sync’s.
Because streaming runs no model at all, only rule matching and threshold alerts.
Because streaming runs on pricier dedicated inference chips with nearly unlimited compute.
optionExplanations: 对；脱离同步的即时延迟预算，秒级窗口内可跑更重的模型或集成，这正是流式的一个优势。
流式的模型可以更大不是更小，正因为它有更宽的延迟余量。
流式当然要用模型打分，不是纯规则匹配。
跑什么芯片和范式无关；关键是流式的异步性放宽了延迟预算，不是算力无限。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — off sync's instant latency budget, a seconds-level window can run heavier models or ensembles, a streaming advantage.
Streaming's models can be larger, not smaller, precisely because it has more latency headroom.
Streaming does use a model to score, not pure rule matching.
The chip is unrelated to paradigm; streaming's async nature relaxes the latency budget, it isn't unlimited compute.

termDefinitions.meaning: 组合多个模型的预测以提升质量的方案，计算更重、延迟更高，同步范式常负担不起。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ensemble combines multiple models' predictions for quality at higher compute and latency, often unaffordable in the sync paradigm.

scenario: 有人主张「流式就是更快的批处理，直接换上就行」，你要点出它的真实运维难点。
scenario_en: Someone claims 'streaming is just faster batch, swap it in', and you must surface its real operational hard parts.
q: 流式近实时有哪些核心工程挑战？(多选)
q_en: What are streaming near-real-time's core engineering challenges? (multiple)
why: 三大挑战：精确一次处理语义（事件不重不漏地被处理一次）；窗口特征与训练口径一致（否则产生偏斜）；管线维护（检查点、背压等有状态运维）。流式不是「更快的批处理」，其运维成本常被低估。它不比批处理便宜，成本不是这里的挑战点。
why_en: The hard parts are exactly-once semantics, windowed-feature consistency with training (else skew), and pipeline maintenance (checkpointing, backpressure); streaming isn't just faster batch and its op cost is underestimated.
options: 精确一次处理语义：事件不重不漏地恰好处理一次
窗口特征与训练口径一致，否则产生训练-服务偏斜
有状态管线维护：检查点、背压等运维负担
它一定比批处理更便宜，成本从不是问题
options_en: Exactly-once processing semantics: each event processed exactly once, no duplicates or drops.
Windowed-feature consistency with training, else training-serving skew results.
Stateful pipeline maintenance: checkpointing, backpressure, and related operational burden.
It's always cheaper than batch, so cost is never an issue.
optionExplanations: 对；流处理最难的保证之一就是精确一次，重复或丢事件都会污染特征和结果。
对；线上窗口特征若和训练时算法不一致，就会引入偏斜，是流式特有的一致性难点。
对；有状态流处理要管检查点、背压，运维复杂度远高于无状态服务。
错；流式运维成本常被低估、不比批处理便宜，成本反而是要警惕的点，不是「从不是问题」。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — exactly-once is one of stream processing's hardest guarantees; duplicates or drops corrupt features and results.
Correct — if online windowed features differ from training's computation, skew appears, a streaming-specific consistency challenge.
Correct — stateful streaming must manage checkpointing and backpressure, far more operationally complex than stateless serving.
Wrong — streaming's op cost is underestimated and it isn't cheaper than batch; cost is a caution, not a non-issue.

termDefinitions.term: exactly-once semantics / 精确一次语义
termDefinitions.meaning: 流处理保证每个事件恰好被处理一次，既不丢也不重复，避免特征/计数被污染。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exactly-once semantics guarantee each event is processed once — no drops or duplicates — so features and counts aren't corrupted.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理速度跟不上上游事件速率时的反向节流机制，防止系统被淹没。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure is a reverse throttling mechanism when downstream can't keep up with the upstream event rate, preventing overload.

termDefinitions.meaning: 定期保存流处理的状态快照，故障后可从检查点恢复，保证有状态计算不丢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Checkpointing periodically snapshots stream-processing state so it can recover after failure without losing stateful computation.

scenario: 你同时维护批处理特征库和流式特征库，担心两边同一个特征算出来不一致，导致模型行为漂移。
scenario_en: You maintain both a batch and a streaming feature store and fear the same feature diverging across them, drifting model behavior.
q: 为什么流式常配 dual-write（双写）模式，它解决什么？
q_en: Why does streaming often use a dual-write pattern, and what does it solve?
why: 双写让同一份特征同时写进批处理特征库和流式特征库，保持两边一致，避免「批算的特征和流算的特征对不上」造成的偏斜与漂移。代价是写路径更复杂、要处理两边一致性和失败重试。
why_en: Dual-write writes the same feature into both batch and streaming feature stores to keep them consistent, avoiding skew/drift from divergent feature values, at the cost of a more complex write path.
options: 把同一特征同时写进批处理和流式特征库，保证两边一致
双写指把模型复制两份同时跑，纯粹为了冗余和灰度备份
双写指每条数据写两遍数据库副本，用来提高读吞吐
双写是把预测结果同时发给用户和日志，与特征一致性无关
options_en: It writes the same feature into both the batch and streaming stores so the two stay consistent.
Dual-write means running two copies of the model at once, purely for redundancy and canary backup.
Dual-write means writing each record to two database replicas to raise read throughput.
Dual-write means sending predictions to both the user and logs, unrelated to feature consistency.
optionExplanations: 对；把特征同步写进两个特征库保持口径一致，正是双写要解决的批/流特征不一致问题。
双写针对的是特征库一致性，不是模型副本冗余。
写两遍库提读性能是别的概念，双写解决的是批/流两套特征库对齐。
双写关乎特征一致性，不是把预测同时发用户和日志。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — synchronizing the feature into both stores to keep definitions aligned is exactly what dual-write solves.
Dual-write targets feature-store consistency, not model-copy redundancy.
Writing twice for read performance is a different concept; dual-write aligns the batch and streaming feature stores.
Dual-write concerns feature consistency, not sending predictions to both user and logs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把同一份特征同时写入批处理与流式两个特征库，使两边取值一致，抑制偏斜和漂移。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dual-write writes the same feature into both the batch and streaming feature stores so values stay consistent, suppressing skew and drift.

scenario: 团队打算把一个批处理特征管线直接改成流式，理由是「流式就是更快的批处理」。
scenario_en: The team plans to convert a batch feature pipeline to streaming, reasoning 'streaming is just faster batch'.
q: 把「流式=更快的批处理」当决策依据有什么风险？
q_en: What's the risk of treating 'streaming = faster batch' as a decision basis?
why: 风险是低估了流式的运维成本：它需要精确一次语义、有状态检查点、背压处理、窗口一致性等，这些持续的运维负担在批处理里根本不存在。把它当「更快的批处理」会漏算这些成本，上线后被运维复杂度反噬。
why_en: The risk is underestimating streaming's operational cost — exactly-once, checkpointing, backpressure, window consistency — none of which batch has, so treating it as faster batch undercounts ongoing ops burden.
options: 没有风险，流式确实只是更快的批处理，直接换更好
低估运维成本：精确一次、检查点、背压这些批处理都没有
风险只是延迟略高一点，功能和结果上和批处理没有差别
风险是流式一定更便宜，会让预算花不完而被下一年砍掉
options_en: No risk — streaming really is just faster batch, so swapping in is strictly better.
It underestimates ops cost: exactly-once, checkpointing, and backpressure simply do not exist in batch.
The only risk is slightly higher latency; functionally the results match batch.
The risk is streaming being always cheaper, leaving budget unspent and cut next year.
optionExplanations: 流式不是「更快的批处理」，它引入了一整套批处理没有的有状态运维负担。
对；持续的精确一次/检查点/背压/窗口一致性成本常被低估，这是那句「不只是更快的批处理」的告诫。
差别远不止延迟：语义保证和有状态运维是本质不同，功能与可靠性都不一样。
流式通常比批处理更贵、运维更重，不会让预算花不完。
optionExplanations_en: Streaming isn't 'faster batch'; it introduces a whole stateful ops burden batch lacks.
Correct — ongoing exactly-once/checkpointing/backpressure/window-consistency costs are underestimated, the point of 'not just faster batch'.
The difference is far beyond latency: semantic guarantees and stateful ops are fundamentally different in function and reliability.
Streaming is usually costlier and more ops-heavy than batch, not budget-saving.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统上线后持续运行、监控、故障恢复所需的人力与资源投入；流式的这部分成本常被低估。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Operational cost is the ongoing human and resource effort to run, monitor, and recover a system in production; streaming's is commonly underestimated.

scenario: 面试官提醒：命名服务范式之前，应先讲清哪三个约束？
scenario_en: The interviewer hints: before naming a serving paradigm, which three constraints should you state?
q: 选服务范式前，应先明确哪三个约束、并按谁做第一决策轴？
q_en: Before choosing a paradigm, which three constraints do you state, and which is the first axis?
why: 先说清延迟 SLA、预估 QPS、新鲜度要求这三条约束，再命名范式，体现约束驱动的推理。第一决策轴是延迟预算：请求路径上要亚 100ms（广告/搜索/欺诈）→ 必须同步；可容忍小时级 → 批处理；要新鲜但毫秒不强求（会话/异常）→ 流式。
why_en: State latency SLA, estimated QPS, and freshness first, then name the paradigm; the first axis is the latency budget — sub-100ms on the request path forces sync, hours-tolerant means batch, fresh-but-not-ms means streaming.
tradeoff: 先声明延迟/QPS/新鲜度再选范式（约束驱动）vs 先拍范式（易与真实约束错配）
whenOtherWins: 如果延迟预算宽松（小时级可接受），第一决策轴就退给成本/吞吐，直接选最便宜的批处理，而不是被延迟主导。
options: 先按团队最熟的技术栈选范式，约束等设计评审时再补上
先定延迟 SLA/QPS/新鲜度三约束，以延迟预算为第一决策轴
先选最便宜的批处理，等延迟不够用了再改造成同步
只看模型大小决定范式，模型大就同步、小就批处理
options_en: Pick the paradigm from the team’s most familiar stack and backfill constraints at design review.
State latency SLA, QPS, and freshness first, then let the latency budget be the first decision axis.
Start with the cheapest batch and rebuild it into sync once latency proves insufficient.
Decide purely by model size: big model to sync, small model to batch.
optionExplanations: 按熟悉度而非约束选范式，容易和真实延迟/新鲜度需求错配，正是要避免的反模式。
对；先摆三约束、以延迟预算为第一轴，是约束驱动推理，能干净地把场景映射到范式。
无脑先选批处理会在有严格延迟需求时翻车；延迟预算应先于成本判断。
模型大小是实现细节，不是选范式的第一决策轴；延迟/新鲜度/吞吐才是。
optionExplanations_en: Choosing by familiarity rather than constraints easily mismatches real latency/freshness needs — the anti-pattern to avoid.
Correct — stating three constraints with latency budget as the first axis is constraint-driven reasoning that cleanly maps scenario to paradigm.
Blindly picking batch fails under strict latency needs; latency budget should precede the cost judgment.
Model size is an implementation detail, not the first axis; latency/freshness/throughput are.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对响应时间的服务级承诺（如 p99 < 100ms），是选服务范式的第一决策轴。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A latency SLA is a service-level commitment on response time (e.g. p99 < 100ms), the first axis for choosing a serving paradigm.

scenario: 面试里要按约束一步步推出服务范式，而不是张口就报一个。请把决策指南排好。
scenario_en: In an interview, derive the serving paradigm step by step from constraints rather than blurting one out. Order the guide.
q: 把「选服务范式」的决策指南排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the decision guide for choosing a serving paradigm:
steps: 先看延迟预算：亚 100ms 在请求路径→同步；小时级可容忍→批；要新鲜但非毫秒→流式
再看吞吐：百万-十亿/次跑→批；高 QPS 每请求→同步+自动扩缩；持续中等→流式
用成本当平手裁决：批最便宜、同步最贵、流式居中
MAANG 常混用：批预算冷启动/兜底 + 实时给活跃用户打分，特征存储做统一层
why: 决策顺序：延迟预算是第一轴→吞吐是第二轴→成本当平手裁决→现实里混用（批做冷启动/兜底，实时给活跃用户，特征存储统一）。先延迟后吞吐再成本，最后落到 hybrid，是约束驱动的完整推理。
why_en: Latency budget first, then throughput, cost as tiebreaker, and in reality hybrid — batch for cold-start/fallback plus real-time for active users, unified by a feature store.
diagram:
flowchart TB
  L["1. 延迟预算"] --> T["2. 吞吐"]
  T --> C["3. 成本平手裁决"]
  C --> H["4. 现实多为 hybrid"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时用多种服务范式：如批处理预算冷启动/兜底、实时给活跃用户打分，用特征存储统一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hybrid architecture combines paradigms — e.g. batch for cold-start/fallback plus real-time for active users — unified by a feature store.

scenario: 外卖 App 要在下单页对餐厅做重排序，依据是用户实时 GPS 和最近 30 秒的浏览行为，延迟预算 200ms，用户在等页面加载。
scenario_en: A food-delivery app re-ranks restaurants on the order page using live GPS and the last 30s of browsing, within a 200ms budget while the user waits for the page.
q: 这种实时特征 + 200ms 预算的重排序该用哪种范式？
q_en: Which paradigm fits real-time features with a 200ms budget re-rank?
why: 实时 GPS 和最近 30 秒浏览只有请求时才存在，200ms 又卡在用户等待的加载路径上，只有同步能在一次往返里取特征并打分。
why_en: Use synchronous real-time inference with a low-latency feature store because the re-rank is on the 200ms request path and depends on live GPS and last-30s browsing available only at request time.
tradeoff: 同步+低延迟特征存储（200ms 内用实时特征打分）vs 批处理（便宜但预算不到实时 GPS/浏览特征）
whenOtherWins: 如果重排序不依赖此刻的实时信号、可用预算好的结果（如首页默认榜单、新鲜度可放宽），就改用更省的批处理。
options: 异步批处理：提前把每家餐厅的排序算好存起来，下单页查表
同步实时推理 + 低延迟特征存储：200ms 内取实时特征打分
流式近实时：把浏览事件进 Kafka，几秒后再更新排序
纯规则按直线距离排序，不用模型也不取任何实时特征
options_en: Async batch: pre-compute each restaurant's ranking and look it up on the order page.
Synchronous real-time inference plus a low-latency feature store: fetch live features and score within 200ms.
Streaming near-real-time: push browsing events into Kafka and update the ranking a few seconds later.
Pure straight-line-distance rule sorting, using no model and no real-time features.
optionExplanations: 批处理提前算好的排序拿不到用户此刻的位置和刚看过的店，个性化就失效了。
对；请求时才有的信号必须在同一次往返里取到，低延迟特征存储把取特征压到个位数毫秒，才留得出模型前向的时间。
秒级的流式赶不上 200ms 预算，用户在同步等页面加载，太慢。
纯距离规则丢掉了实时浏览行为和模型个性化，达不到重排序的目标。
optionExplanations_en: A pre-computed batch ranking can't see where the user is standing now or what they just browsed, so personalization breaks.
Correct — request-time signals must be fetched inside the same round-trip, and a low-latency store keeps that fetch to single-digit ms so the forward pass still fits.
Streaming's seconds can't meet a 200ms budget while the user synchronously waits for the page — too slow.
Pure distance rules drop live browsing and model personalization, missing the re-rank goal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在候选已初排的基础上，用请求时的实时特征对结果重新打分排序，追求即时个性化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Re-ranking re-scores an already-ranked candidate set using request-time real-time features for immediate personalization.

scenario: 一个大规模推荐系统既要覆盖冷启动/兜底、又要给活跃用户即时个性化，单一范式顾此失彼。
scenario_en: A large-scale recommender must cover cold-start/fallback and give active users instant personalization; a single paradigm can't do both well.
q: MAANG 规模系统通常怎么组合服务范式？
q_en: How do MAANG-scale systems usually combine paradigms?
why: 用混合架构：批处理预算冷启动和兜底结果（便宜、覆盖长尾），实时推理给活跃用户做即时打分（新鲜、个性化），两者由特征存储做统一层保证特征一致。这样各取所长——批处理压成本、同步保新鲜，避免单一范式的短板。
why_en: Use a hybrid — batch pre-computes cold-start/fallback cheaply while real-time scores active users freshly, unified by a feature store — taking each paradigm's strength and avoiding its weakness.
tradeoff: 混合（批压成本+实时保新鲜，但要维护两套+统一层）vs 单一范式（简单，但顾此失彼）
whenOtherWins: 如果系统规模小、流量低、需求单一（只要便宜或只要新鲜），单一范式更简单，不必背上维护两套管线和特征统一层的复杂度。
options: 只用同步一种范式，所有预测都在线现算，简单统一
混合：批处理兜底冷启动 + 实时给活跃用户打分
只用批处理一种，牺牲所有活跃用户的新鲜度换成本
为每个用户单独搭一套独立推理管线，互不复用
options_en: Use only synchronous, computing every prediction online for simplicity and uniformity.
Hybrid: batch covers cold-start and fallback while real-time scores active users.
Use only batch, sacrificing all active users' freshness to cut cost.
Build a separate independent inference pipeline per user with no reuse across them.
optionExplanations: 全同步在冷启动和长尾上白烧算力，成本失控，也没必要对不活跃用户实时现算。
对；批做便宜的冷启动/兜底、实时给活跃用户保新鲜，特征存储统一口径，是 MAANG 的主流做法。
全批处理让活跃用户吃陈旧结果，损失即时个性化，顾此失彼。
为每个用户单独搭管线不可扩展、无法复用，工程上不成立。
optionExplanations_en: All-sync wastes compute on cold-start and the long tail, blowing up cost with no need to infer live for inactive users.
Correct — batch for cheap cold-start/fallback plus real-time freshness for active users, unified by a feature store, is the MAANG mainstream.
All-batch feeds active users stale results, losing instant personalization.
A per-user pipeline is unscalable and non-reusable, engineering-infeasible.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对新用户/新物品缺乏交互历史时的预测问题，常用批处理预算的通用/兜底结果覆盖。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold-start is predicting for new users/items with little interaction history, often covered by batch-precomputed generic/fallback results.

scenario: 混合架构里批处理、同步、流式三条路各自算特征，你怕它们口径不一致造成偏斜。
scenario_en: In a hybrid, batch, sync, and streaming each compute features, and you fear inconsistent definitions cause skew.
q: 特征存储在混合架构里扮演什么角色？
q_en: What role does the feature store play in a hybrid architecture?
why: 特征存储是把三种范式黏合起来的统一层：让训练、批处理、同步、流式都读同一份特征定义和取值，保证跨范式一致，从根上抑制训练-服务偏斜。它既服务离线训练，又给在线服务提供低延迟取特征。
why_en: The feature store is the unifying layer that lets training, batch, sync, and streaming read the same feature definitions and values, keeping them consistent across paradigms and suppressing skew.
options: 它只是给同步服务加的一个缓存，与训练和批处理无关
统一层：训练/批/同步/流式读同一份特征定义与取值
它是训练用的数据集划分工具，只在离线阶段发挥作用
它是模型注册表，只存模型版本和指标，不存任何特征
options_en: It's just a cache bolted onto the sync service, unrelated to training and batch.
The unifying layer: training, batch, sync, and streaming all read one set of feature definitions and values.
It is a training-time dataset-splitting tool that only matters in the offline stage.
It is a model registry that stores model versions and metrics only, never features.
optionExplanations: 特征存储服务于训练、批、同步、流式所有路径，不只是同步的缓存。
对；统一特征定义与取值、跨范式一致，是特征存储在混合架构里黏合各路、抑制偏斜的核心作用。
它恰恰同时服务离线训练和在线服务，不是纯训练期工具。
特征存储存的是特征不是模型版本，那是模型注册表的职责。
optionExplanations_en: The feature store serves training, batch, sync, and streaming, not just a sync cache.
Correct — unifying feature definitions and values across paradigms is its core glue role in a hybrid, suppressing skew.
It serves both offline training and online serving, not a training-only tool.
It stores features, not model versions — that's the model registry's job.

termDefinitions.meaning: 集中管理特征定义、离线和在线取值的系统，作为混合架构的统一层保证跨范式一致、抑制偏斜。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store centrally manages feature definitions and offline/online values as a hybrid's unifying layer, keeping paradigms consistent and suppressing skew.

scenario: 同一个模型，上同步线要压到毫秒预算，走批处理则没有即时延迟约束。
scenario_en: The same model must fit a ms budget on sync but has no instant-latency constraint in batch.
q: 同步 vs 批处理在能跑的模型保真度上有什么区别？
q_en: How do sync vs batch differ in the model fidelity they can run?
why: 同步受毫秒延迟预算约束，常得靠量化/蒸馏把模型压小、牺牲一点精度换速度；批处理没有即时延迟约束，可以跑全保真度的大模型甚至集成。取舍轴是「延迟预算 vs 模型保真度」。
why_en: Sync is bound by a ms budget and often needs quantization/distillation to shrink the model, trading accuracy for speed, while batch has no instant-latency constraint and can run full-fidelity large models or ensembles.
tradeoff: 同步（压小模型保延迟，损一点精度）vs 批处理（全保真度大模型/集成，但结果陈旧）
options: 两者能跑的模型完全一样，延迟预算只影响机器数量不影响模型
同步能跑更大的模型，因为它有专用 GPU 而且跑得更快
同步常需量化/蒸馏压小模型，批处理可跑全保真度大模型
批处理只能跑小模型，同步才能跑大模型，正好相反
options_en: Both run identical models; the latency budget changes only machine count, not model choice.
Sync can run larger models because it owns dedicated GPUs and runs faster.
Sync often needs quantization or distillation to shrink models, while batch can run full-fidelity large ones.
Batch can only run small models and sync runs large ones — exactly reversed.
optionExplanations: 延迟预算恰恰决定了同步得压小模型、批处理能跑大模型，绝非无影响。
同步更快不等于能跑更大模型；正因延迟紧它反而得把模型压小。
对；这就是取舍轴——同步用保真度换延迟，批处理用陈旧换保真度。
说反了：批处理能跑全保真度大模型，同步才受限要压小。
optionExplanations_en: The latency budget is exactly what forces sync to shrink and lets batch run large models — far from irrelevant.
Sync being fast doesn't mean larger models; the tight budget forces it to shrink instead.
Correct — that's the axis: sync trades fidelity for latency, batch trades staleness for fidelity.
Reversed: batch runs full-fidelity large models, sync is the constrained one that shrinks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型未经压缩、保留完整容量与精度的程度；批处理可跑全保真度，同步常需牺牲保真度换延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Model fidelity is how uncompressed and full-capacity a model is; batch can run full fidelity while sync often trades it for latency.

scenario: 面试官给出同步广告排序的延迟目标是 p99 亚 50-100ms，问你这个数怎么约束设计。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives a sync ad-ranking latency target of p99 sub-50-100ms and asks how it constrains design.
q: 同步服务的「p99 亚 50-100ms」这个数意味着什么设计约束？
q_en: What design constraint does a sync service's 'p99 sub-50-100ms' imply?
why: p99 亚 50-100ms 是给定的 SLO 目标、不是公式推导值。这点预算要覆盖取特征+模型前向+网络，逼着你量化压小模型并按尾延迟规划容量。
why_en: p99 sub-50-100ms is a given SLO target, not a formula — 99% of requests must beat it — and since the budget must cover feature fetch plus forward pass plus network, it forces model compression and tail-latency capacity planning.
options: 它是由 QPS 和用户数算出的精确公式结果，改参数就会变
它是给定的 SLO 目标：预算要覆盖取特征+前向+网络
它只是平均延迟，偶尔超一点无所谓，不影响设计
它指模型每 50-100ms 更新一次权重，与请求延迟无关
options_en: It's an exact formula result from QPS and user count; change the params and it changes.
It is a given SLO target, and the budget must cover feature fetch, forward pass, and network.
It's just the average latency; occasionally exceeding it is fine and doesn't affect design.
It means the model updates weights every 50-100ms, unrelated to request latency.
optionExplanations: 这个数是产品定的 SLO 目标，不是从 QPS 推导出的公式值，性质不同。
对；它是「99% 快于此」的目标，预算被取特征+前向+网络瓜分，留给模型的很少，逼你压小模型、按尾延迟扩容。
p99 恰恰盯的是最慢 1% 而非平均，偶尔超标就违反 SLO，直接影响容量与模型设计。
它约束的是请求响应延迟，不是模型权重更新频率。
optionExplanations_en: The number is a product-set SLO target, not a formula derived from QPS — a different nature.
Correct — it's a '99% faster than this' target, and with the budget split across feature fetch, forward pass, and network, it forces shrinking the model and sizing by the tail.
p99 targets the slowest 1%, not the average; occasionally exceeding it violates the SLO and directly drives capacity and model design.
It constrains request response latency, not the model's weight-update frequency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务级目标，如「p99 < 100ms」，是产品设定的性能目标而非公式推导值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SLO (Service Level Objective) is a performance target like 'p99 < 100ms', a product-set goal rather than a formula result.

scenario: 延迟和吞吐都能满足时，面试官让你用成本当平手裁决，给三种范式的成本排序。
scenario_en: When latency and throughput both fit, the interviewer asks you to break the tie by cost — rank the three paradigms.
q: 按成本，三种范式怎么排序，这在决策里起什么作用？
q_en: By cost, how do the three paradigms rank, and what role does that play?
why: 成本从低到高：批处理最便宜（用完即走、大 batch 高利用率、spot），流式居中（持续运行），同步最贵（按峰值常备算力）。成本是平手裁决——当延迟和吞吐约束都满足、多个范式都可行时，用成本排序选最省的那个。
why_en: Batch is cheapest, streaming in between, sync most expensive; cost is the tiebreaker used to pick the cheapest feasible paradigm once latency and throughput are both satisfied.
tradeoff: 成本作平手裁决：批最便宜 < 流式居中 < 同步最贵；先满足延迟/吞吐，再用成本选最省
options: 同步最便宜 < 流式 < 批处理最贵，成本是第一决策轴
三者成本基本相同，所以成本不参与范式决策
批处理最便宜 < 流式 < 同步最贵；成本是平手裁决
流式最便宜，因为它只在事件到来时才消耗算力
options_en: Sync cheapest < streaming < batch most expensive, and cost is the first axis.
All three cost about the same, so cost plays no part in choosing a paradigm.
Batch cheapest, streaming in the middle, sync priciest — cost is the tiebreaker.
Streaming is cheapest because it consumes compute only when events arrive.
optionExplanations: 顺序反了，且成本是平手裁决而非第一轴——第一轴是延迟预算。
三者成本差异明显（批用完即走 vs 同步常备），成本当然参与决策。
对；批 < 流式 < 同步，成本用来在延迟/吞吐都满足时选最省的那个，是平手裁决。
流式是持续运行、成本居中，不是最便宜；最便宜的是用完即走的批处理。
optionExplanations_en: The order is reversed, and cost is a tiebreaker, not the first axis — latency budget is first.
The three differ clearly (batch spins down vs sync always-on), so cost does factor in.
Correct — batch < streaming < sync, and cost picks the cheapest once latency/throughput are met, as a tiebreaker.
Streaming runs continuously at moderate cost, not cheapest; the cheapest is spin-down batch.

termDefinitions.meaning: 当多个方案在主约束（延迟/吞吐）上都可行时，用来做最终取舍的次级标准，这里是成本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tiebreaker is a secondary criterion used to decide when several options all satisfy the primary constraints (latency/throughput); here it's cost.

scenario: 一个批处理作业要在一次运行里给数百万到数十亿条 用户×候选 打分，问你这对范式选择意味着什么。
scenario_en: A batch job must score millions-to-billions of user x candidate rows per run; what does this imply for paradigm choice.
q: 「一次跑百万-十亿条」这个吞吐量把设计推向哪种范式？
q_en: Which paradigm does 'millions-to-billions per run' throughput push toward?
why: 百万-十亿/次的巨量、可预先枚举的预测集，把设计推向异步批处理：一次大 batch 把海量样本喂满 GPU、利用率最高、单条成本最低，再把结果存起来供查表。若换成每请求同步现算这么大的集合，成本和延迟都撑不住。
why_en: A pre-enumerable set of millions-to-billions per run pushes toward async batch, where one large batch maxes GPU utilization at lowest per-item cost, versus infeasible per-request synchronous scoring at that scale.
options: 推向同步实时，每请求现算，靠自动扩缩硬扛十亿量级
异步批处理：大 batch 喂满 GPU，单条成本最低
推向流式，把十亿条拆成十亿个事件逐条流式处理
吞吐量只影响机器数量，和范式选择没有关系
options_en: Toward synchronous real-time, scoring per request and brute-forcing billions via autoscaling.
Async batch: a large batch saturates the GPU at the lowest per-item cost.
Toward streaming, splitting a billion rows into a billion events processed one at a time.
Throughput only changes machine count and has nothing to do with paradigm choice.
optionExplanations: 对十亿量级、可预枚举的集合每请求现算，成本和延迟都爆炸，自动扩缩也扛不住。
对；巨量可预枚举集合正是批处理主场，大 batch 高利用率、低单条成本，存结果查表。
把预枚举的十亿条硬拆成事件流是自找运维复杂度，批处理一次跑完更合适。
吞吐量是选范式的第二决策轴，绝非无关。
optionExplanations_en: Scoring a pre-enumerable billion-scale set per request explodes cost and latency; autoscaling can't carry it.
Correct — a huge pre-enumerable set is batch's home turf, with large-batch high utilization and low per-item cost, storing results for lookup.
Forcing a pre-enumerable billion rows into an event stream invites needless ops complexity; batch runs it in one pass.
Throughput is the second decision axis, far from irrelevant.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单位时间能处理的预测/请求数量；巨量可预枚举的预测集适合批处理一次算完。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Throughput is predictions/requests processed per unit time; a huge pre-enumerable prediction set suits batch computing it all at once.

scenario: IoT 设备流要做异常检测，要求秒级发出告警，但不需要卡在某个用户请求的亚 100ms 关键路径上。
scenario_en: An IoT device stream needs anomaly detection with alerts in seconds, but not on any user's sub-100ms request critical path.
q: IoT 秒级异常告警该用哪种服务范式？
q_en: Which paradigm fits IoT seconds-level anomaly alerting?
why: 用流式近实时：设备事件持续进 Kafka、由流处理器算窗口特征并检测异常，秒级发告警。它要的是新鲜度和持续处理而非亚 100ms 同步响应，也没法等批处理的小时级。这正是流式填补同步与批处理空档的典型场景。
why_en: Use streaming near-real-time — device events into Kafka, windowed anomaly detection, alerts in seconds — since it needs freshness and continuous processing, not sub-100ms sync nor hours-late batch.
tradeoff: 流式（秒级持续告警，运维复杂）vs 批处理（便宜，但小时级告警太迟）
whenOtherWins: 如果异常判定不急、可接受小时/天级回顾（如离线合规审计），批处理更省；若必须在某个同步请求内即时拦截，才上同步。
options: 同步实时：每个设备读数都发一次 HTTP 请求等模型同步返回
流式近实时：事件进 Kafka、流处理器算窗口特征检测异常，秒级告警
异步批处理：每天凌晨跑一次异常检测，白天看报告
把阈值写死在设备固件里，永不更新模型
options_en: Synchronous real-time: each device reading fires an HTTP request and waits for a synchronous model return.
Streaming near-real-time: events into Kafka, stream processor computes windowed features and detects anomalies, alerting in seconds.
Async batch: run anomaly detection once at dawn daily and read reports during the day.
Hard-code thresholds into the device firmware and never update the model.
optionExplanations: IoT 异常检测不需要亚 100ms 同步响应，为每条读数做同步往返是过度设计、成本高。
对；持续消费事件、窗口检测、秒级告警正是流式定位，填补同步与批处理之间的空档。
每天一次太迟，异常要秒级发现，批处理的小时/天级新鲜度不够。
写死固件阈值丢掉了模型和持续更新能力，达不到异常检测目标。
optionExplanations_en: IoT anomaly detection doesn't need sub-100ms sync; a synchronous round-trip per reading over-engineers it at high cost.
Correct — continuous event consumption, windowed detection, and seconds-level alerts is streaming's niche, filling the sync-to-batch gap.
Once daily is too late; anomalies need seconds-level detection, and batch's hourly/daily freshness is insufficient.
Hard-coded firmware thresholds drop the model and continuous updates, missing the anomaly-detection goal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 物联网：大量联网设备持续产生事件流，常用流式做窗口聚合与异常检测。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IoT (Internet of Things) is many networked devices producing continuous event streams, commonly processed by streaming for windowed aggregation and anomaly detection.

scenario: 同步服务要在个位数毫秒内取到用户/上下文特征来打分，你在选特征取用的存储。
scenario_en: A sync service must fetch user/context features in single-digit ms to score, and you're choosing the feature-serving store.
q: 为什么同步服务的请求时特征取用要放在 Redis/DynamoDB 这类存储？
q_en: Why put a sync service's request-time feature fetch in a store like Redis/DynamoDB?
why: 因为整个响应只有几十毫秒预算，取特征这一步必须个位数毫秒内完成：Redis 是内存 KV、DynamoDB 是托管低延迟 KV，按 key 点查稳定快。若把特征放进要扫描或做联表的关系库/数仓，延迟到几十上百毫秒，直接吃穿延迟预算。
why_en: Because the whole response has only tens of ms and the feature fetch must finish in single-digit ms, so an in-memory/managed KV (Redis, DynamoDB) does fast point lookups, unlike a scan/join in a warehouse that would blow the budget.
options: 因为它们能跑复杂 SQL 联表，特征算得更全
因为个位数毫秒点查是硬需求，数仓扫描会吃穿延迟预算
因为它们最便宜，选它纯粹是为了压低存储成本
因为它们能永久保存全部历史特征，容量上限最大
options_en: Because they can run complex SQL joins for richer features.
Because single-digit-millisecond point lookups are a hard requirement and warehouse scans blow the budget.
Because they are the cheapest, chosen purely to cut storage cost.
Because they keep all historical features forever and have the largest capacity ceiling.
optionExplanations: 选它们恰恰不是为了跑联表——KV 按 key 点查才快，复杂 SQL 反而慢。
对；同步延迟预算逼着取特征必须个位数毫秒，内存/托管 KV 的点查稳定命中这个预算，数仓扫描来不及。
选它们首要是低延迟点查，不是便宜；成本是次要考量。
选它们是为低延迟点查，不是为最大容量或永久存全量历史。
optionExplanations_en: They're chosen precisely not for joins — KV point lookups by key are fast, while complex SQL is slow.
Correct — the sync budget forces single-digit-ms fetches, and in-memory/managed KV point lookups hit that budget while warehouse scans can't.
They're chosen first for low-latency lookups, not cheapness; cost is secondary.
They're chosen for low-latency lookups, not maximum capacity or forever-history storage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按主键直接取一条记录的查询，KV 存储的点查是稳定的个位数毫秒，适合请求时取特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A point lookup fetches one record by primary key; KV stores do this in stable single-digit ms, ideal for request-time feature fetch.

scenario: 把三种服务范式的一句话定位背下来，面试里能按约束秒选。
scenario_en: Memorize each serving paradigm's one-line niche so you can pick by constraint instantly.
q: 补全三种服务范式的定位口诀。
q_en: Fill in the one-line niche of each serving paradigm.
text: 亚 100ms 卡在请求关键路径（广告/搜索/欺诈）→ {{同步}}；小时级可容忍、预测集有界 → {{批处理}}（异步）；要新鲜但毫秒不强求（会话/异常）→ {{流式}}。三者共有的首要风险是 {{训练-服务偏斜}}。
text_en: Sub-100ms on the request critical path (ads/search/fraud) → {{synchronous}}; hours-tolerant with a bounded set → {{batch}} (async); fresh-but-not-ms (session/anomaly) → {{streaming}}. The shared first-order risk is {{training-serving skew}}.
why: 这四空是本章骨架：延迟卡死用同步、可陈旧用批、要新鲜但不卡死用流式，而三者都要防训练-服务偏斜。记住「约束→范式」这一步，面试里就能先声明延迟/QPS/新鲜度再报范式。
why_en: Sync for hard latency, batch for staleness-tolerant, streaming for fresh-not-instant, and all three must guard training-serving skew.

termDefinitions.term: training-serving skew / 训练-服务偏斜
termDefinitions.meaning: 服务时特征/逻辑与训练时不一致导致线上掉点，是三种范式共有的首要风险。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is serving-time features/logic diverging from training, degrading production performance — the shared first-order risk.

scenario: 一个推荐场景新鲜度要求介于两者之间：既嫌批处理隔夜太陈旧，又不需要秒级即时，分钟级更新就满意。
scenario_en: A rec use case wants freshness in between: nightly batch is too stale, but it doesn't need seconds — minute-level updates suffice.
q: 新鲜度要求「比批处理高、比同步松」时更该倾向哪种范式？
q_en: When freshness is 'higher than batch, looser than sync', which paradigm to lean toward?
why: 倾向流式近实时：它正是填补批处理（隔夜陈旧）和同步（亚 100ms、贵）之间空档的范式，秒到分钟级持续更新恰好匹配这种中间新鲜度。代价是比批处理运维重（精确一次、检查点、背压），要评估是否值得。
why_en: Lean streaming near-real-time — it fills the gap between stale nightly batch and expensive sub-100ms sync, matching minute-level freshness, at the cost of heavier ops than batch.
tradeoff: 流式（分钟级新鲜、填补空档，但运维重）vs 批处理（更省，但隔夜太陈旧追不上）
whenOtherWins: 如果分钟级新鲜其实并非必要、隔夜也能接受，就退回更便宜、运维更轻的批处理，别为用不上的新鲜度背流式复杂度。
options: 同步实时，反正越新鲜越好，直接上最贵的方案
流式近实时：秒-分钟级更新，正好落在批与同步之间
异步批处理，隔夜跑一次就够，新鲜度还可以再放宽
端上推理，把模型塞进用户设备本地实时计算
options_en: Synchronous real-time — fresher is always better, so just buy the priciest option.
Streaming near-real-time: seconds-to-minutes updates land exactly between batch and sync.
Async batch — one overnight run is enough and freshness can be relaxed further.
On-device inference — put the model on the user’s device and compute locally in real time.
optionExplanations: 同步的亚 100ms 和高成本对分钟级新鲜是过度设计，用不着为不需要的即时性买单。
对；中间新鲜度正是流式的定位，秒-分钟级持续更新填补批与同步之间的空档。
隔夜批处理太陈旧，恰恰是这里要改进的痛点，说新鲜度无所谓与前提矛盾。
端上推理是另一类方案，不解决服务端中间新鲜度的范式选择问题。
optionExplanations_en: Sync's sub-100ms and high cost over-engineer minute-level freshness; no need to pay for unneeded immediacy.
Correct — middle freshness is streaming's niche, with seconds-to-minutes updates filling the batch-to-sync gap.
Nightly batch is too stale — the very pain point here — so 'freshness doesn't matter' contradicts the premise.
On-device is a different approach and doesn't address the server-side middle-freshness paradigm choice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测反映最新数据/行为的及时程度；批处理最陈旧、同步最新鲜、流式介于两者之间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Freshness is how up-to-date a prediction is with the latest data/behavior; batch is stalest, sync freshest, streaming in between.

scenario: 候选人一上来就说「我用同步实时推理」，还没提任何延迟、QPS 或新鲜度数字。
scenario_en: A candidate opens with 'I'll use synchronous real-time inference' before stating any latency, QPS, or freshness numbers.
q: 先报范式、后补约束这种做法在面试里为什么被扣分？
q_en: Why is naming the paradigm before stating constraints penalized in interviews?
why: 因为它是结论先行、没有约束驱动的推理：不先给延迟 SLA、预估 QPS、新鲜度要求，就无法判断同步是不是对的选择，很可能过度设计（明明可批处理却上最贵的同步）或欠设计。正确做法是先声明三约束、再由它们推出范式。
why_en: Because it's a conclusion without constraint-driven reasoning — without a latency SLA, estimated QPS, and freshness, you can't tell if sync is right, risking over- or under-engineering; state constraints first, then derive the paradigm.
options: 不扣分，直接报同步永远是最安全的默认选项
因为结论先行、缺约束驱动：没延迟/QPS 就判不了对错
扣分只因为同步太贵，先报批处理就没有问题
因为面试只看你能不能背出三种范式的名字
options_en: It is not penalized; opening with sync is always the safest default.
Because it leads with a conclusion and skips constraint-driven reasoning: without latency or QPS you cannot judge it.
It is penalized only because sync is expensive; opening with batch would be fine.
Because the interview only checks whether you can recite the three paradigm names.
